about: The stops an unattended run must keep: the 18 of docs/plans/one-go/evidence/v-auto-advance.md section 2 and the calls only the person may cause (the mod's rule personOnly). check names the case or scenario that walks the stop; WP07 fills it. A stop leaves this list only with a decision record.
